summary: Adds a connected structured puzzle-authoring studio with create/read/update/delete, title search, state filters and bounded pagination.
Validates four-category mini puzzles, real calendar dates, unique words, request bodies and query parameters; protects authoring with a local bearer token.
Uses conditional versions and PostgreSQL transactions for metadata, category replacement and retained audit records; proves one-winner conflicts and rollback.
Freezes published content, supports archival without reopening edits, and restricts deletion to never-published drafts without results.
Replaces silent fallback with explicit labeled demo mode and unavailable-store errors; validates hierarchy and fixes deterministic shuffle bounds.
Validates saved game boards/history and coordinates accepted browser writes, preserving corrupt data and rejected moves for recovery exports.
Provides a fresh migration, non-overwriting transactional seed, offline-build fonts, loopback defaults, an isolated PostgreSQL/Chromium harness and nine detailed CRUD learning documents.
Verifies 34 model checks, 10 PostgreSQL scenarios, nine Chromium workflows, production build, lint, repeated seed and two reviewed screenshots.

checks.command: Prisma validate/generate/migrate; 34 Node model tests; 10 PostgreSQL integration cases; seed twice; ESLint; Next production webpack build; nine Chromium workflows
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Next 16.1.6; React 19.2.3; Prisma 6.19.2; PostgreSQL 18.1; Playwright 1.60.0 / Chromium 148

limits: Daily mini authoring only; larger puzzle formats remain outside the implemented studio.
Shared local author token only; no individual accounts, roles, multi-tenant ownership or production authentication/deployment certification.
Initial migration is for an empty learning database; no personal database was migrated.
No durable create-idempotency receipts, notification outbox, hosted deployment, crash/power-loss or full accessibility certification.
Public payloads expose puzzle relationships; no anti-cheating or protected leaderboard claim.
Browser saves coordinate cooperating tabs on localhost/HTTPS; raw/pending exports support manual recovery, with no session-import UI.
